product_wide_rationale: Role ownership and the operator's approval boundary govern every agent and every Product Domain; no individual implementation Domain owns that authority.
summary: Four roles separate operator approval, self-sufficient item delivery, optional RTE coordination, and optional Planner assistance as Product Owner. Six approval classes cover product direction, UI/UX, production application data and irreversible customer-data loss, security decisions, increased spending, and legal obligations. Routine engineering and work management remain agent-owned. Approval-boundary changes require exact-text operator approval; seriousness, Domain count, crucial size, and lack of recovery alone do not create an approval requirement. Runtime consent alignment remains unproved.
title: Four roles and six operator approval classes
